glosses: science (a branch of knowledge or academic discipline dealing with a systematic body of facts or truths)
science, the sciences taken as a whole
academia, scholarship (collective discipline of learning acquired through a scientific or scholarly method; totality of knowledge derived from scientific inquiry)

examples.text: Es ist mehr Kunst als Wissenschaft.
examples.en: It's an art more than a science.

examples.text: Mathematik ist die Grundlage aller Wissenschaften.
examples.en: Mathematics is basic to all sciences.
